statement: In pinned xone, removing one wireless client destroys only its GIP adapter while leaving sibling entries allocated. Receive packet processing errors are logged and normal receive completion may resubmit URBs. Receiver USB disconnect destroys every live adapter; reset-resume also clears adapters before receiver reinitialization. Sibling fairness, universal fault isolation and real recovery timing remain unmeasured.
